capabilities: Sync vault files with Google Drive folders in both directions
Create conflict copies instead of overwriting changed notes
Move deleted files to Drive or Obsidian trash
Sync Obsidian settings and plugins optionally
Resume interrupted syncs and handle large files on mobile
extras: Free and open source; paid GSync Teams add-on for Shared Drives and access management; setup requires creating a Google Cloud OAuth client; warns against double-syncing with Google Drive for Desktop.
motivation: Built for notes that already live in Google Drive and need to reach phones and tablets, rather than requiring an empty vault owned by the plugin.
problem: Obsidian users whose notes already live in Google Drive lack a safe way to sync those folders to mobile devices without an empty vault or a middleman server.

relations.evidence: Two-way sync between an Obsidian vault and a folder in Google Drive
GSync Teams is a separate plugin that works together with GSync.

requires.name: Google Cloud OAuth client ID and secret

summary: Two-way sync tool that keeps an Obsidian vault and Google Drive folders aligned, with conflict copies and mobile support.
